acceptanceCriteria: A cat-file failure produces its own typed error, distinct from the budget refusal
A test injects a cat-file failure and asserts the distinct error
body: Found by scopes-1021c lane. The blob-budget error path in the source view is taken for any git cat-file failure, so an object-missing or process error is reported as a budget refusal. This obscured the cause investigated in V1-1302.

title: Source-view blob-budget refusal also covers git cat-file failures, hiding the real cause (V1-1302)
